full.text: The function of the circulation is to serve the needs of the body tissues—to transport nutrients to the tissues, to transport waste products away, transport hormones from one part of the body to another and, in general, to main tain an appropriate environment in all the tissue fluids for survival and optimal function of the cells.

The rate of blood flow through many tissues is controlled mainly in response to their need for nutrients and removal of waste products of metabolism. In some organs, such as the kidneys, the circulation serves additional functions. Blood flow to the kidney, for example, is far in excess of its metabolic requirements and is related to its excretory function, which requires that a large volume of blood be filtered each minute.

The heart and blood vessels, in turn, are controlled to provide the cardiac output and arterial pressure needed to supply adequate tissue blood flow. What are the mecha nisms for controlling blood volume and blood flow, and how does this process relate to the other functions of the circulation? These are some of the topics and questions that we discuss in this section on the circulation.
PHYSICAL CHARACTERISTICS OF THE CIRCULATION

The circulation, shown in **Figure 14-1**, is divided into the _systemic circulation_ and the _pulmonary circulation._ Because the systemic circulation supplies blood flow to all the tissues of the body except the lungs, it is also called the _greater circulation_ or _peripheral circulation._
Before discussing the details of circulatory function, it is important to un derstand the role of each part of the circulation.
full.lead: Functional Parts of the Circulation.

full.text: The function of the _arteries_ is to transport blood _under high pressure_ to the tissues. For this reason, the arter ies have strong vascular walls, and blood flows at a high velocity in the arteries.

The _arterioles_ are the last small branches of the arterial system; they act as _control conduits_ through which blood is released into the capillaries. Arterioles have strong muscular walls that can close the arterioles completely or, by relax ing, can dilate the vessels severalfold; thus, the arterioles can vastly alter blood flow in each tissue in response to its needs.

The function of the _capillaries_ is to exchange fluid, nutri ents, electrolytes, hormones, and other substances between the blood and interstitial fluid. To serve this role, the capil lary walls are thin and have numerous minute _capillary pores_ permeable to water and other small molecular substances.
The _venules_ collect blood from the capillaries and gradually coalesce into progressively larger veins.

The _veins_ function as conduits for transport of blood from the venules back to the heart. The veins also serve as a major reservoir of extra blood. Because the pressure in the venous system is low, the venous walls are thin. Even so, they are muscular enough to contract or expand and thereby serve as a controllable reservoir for the extra blood, either a small or a large amount, depending on the needs of the circulation.

**Figure 14-1** provides an overview of the cir culation and lists the percentages of total blood volume in major segments of the circulation. For example, about 84% of the entire blood volume of the body is in the sys temic circulation, and 16% is in the heart and lungs. Of the 84% in the systemic circulation, approximately 64% is in the veins, 13% is in the arteries, and 7% is in the sys temic arterioles and capillaries. The heart contains 7% of the blood, and the pulmonary vessels contain 9%.
full.lead: Volumes of Blood in the Different Parts of the Circulation.

full.text: Note particularly that the cross-sectional areas of the veins are much larger than those of the arteries, averag ing about four times those of the corresponding arteries. This difference explains the large blood storage capac ity of the venous system in comparison with the arterial system.

Because the same volume of blood flow (F) must pass through each segment of the circulation each minute, the velocity of blood flow (v) is inversely proportional to the vascular cross-sectional area (A):

Thus, under resting conditions, the velocity averages about 33 cm/sec in the aorta but is only 1/1000 as rapid in the capillaries—about 0.3 mm/sec. However, because the capillaries have a typical length of only 0.3 to 1 mil limeter, the blood remains in the capillaries for only 1 to 3 seconds, which is surprising because all diffusion of nutrient food substances and electrolytes that occurs through the capillary walls must be performed in this short time.

Because the heart pumps blood continually into the aorta, the mean pressure in the aorta is high, aver aging about 100 mm Hg. Also, because heart pumping is pulsatile, the arterial pressure normally alternates between an average _systolic pressure level_ of 120 mm Hg and a _diastolic pressure level_ of 80 mm Hg un der resting conditions, as shown on the left side of **Figure 14-2**.
full.lead: Pressures in the Various Portions of the Circulation.

full.text: As the blood flows through the _systemic circulation,_ its mean pressure falls progressively to about 0 mm Hg by the time it reaches the termination of the superior and inferior venae cavae where they empty into the right atrium of the heart.

The pressure in many of the systemic capillaries varies from as high as 35 mm Hg near the arteriolar ends to as low as 10 mm Hg near the venous ends, but their aver age functional pressure in most vascular beds is about 17 mm Hg, a pressure low enough that little of the plasma leaks through the minute _pores_ of the capillary walls, even though nutrients can _diffuse_ easily through these same pores to the outlying tissue cells. In some capillaries, such as the glomerular capillaries of the kidneys, the pressure is considerably higher, averaging about 60 mm Hg and caus ing much higher rates of fluid filtration.

At the far-right side of **Figure 14-2**, note the respective pressures in the different parts of the _pulmonary circula tion._ In the pulmonary arteries, the pressure is pulsatile, just as in the aorta, but the pressure is far less; _pulmo nary artery systolic pressure_ averages about 25 mm Hg and _diastolic pressure_ averages about 8 mm Hg, with a mean pulmonary arterial pressure of only 16 mm Hg. The mean pulmonary capillary pressure averages only 7 mm Hg. Yet, the total blood flow through the lungs each min ute is the same as through the systemic circulation. The low pressures of the pulmonary system are in accord with the needs of the lungs because all that is required is to expose the blood in the pulmonary capillaries to oxygen and other gases in the pulmonary alveoli.
BASIC PRINCIPLES OF CIRCULATORY FUNCTION

Although the details of circulatory function are com plex, three basic principles underlie all functions of the system. 1. _Blood flow to most tissues is controlled according to the tissue needs._ When tissues are active, they need an increased supply of nutrients and therefore more blood flow than when at rest, occasionally as much as 20 to 30 times the resting level. However, the heart normally cannot increase its cardiac output more than four to seven times higher than resting levels. Therefore, it is not possible simply to increase blood flow everywhere in the body when a particular tissue demands increased flow. Instead, the microvessels of each tissue, especially the arterioles, continuously monitor tissue needs, such as the availability of oxy gen and other nutrients and the accumulation of car bon dioxide and other tissue waste products. These microvessels, in turn, dilate or constrict to control local blood flow at the level required for the tissue activity. Also, nervous control of the circulation from the central nervous system and hormones provides additional help in controlling tissue blood flow.

2. _Cardiac output is the sum of all the local tissue flows._ When blood flows through a tissue, it imme diately returns by way of the veins to the heart. The heart responds automatically to this increased in flow of blood by pumping it immediately back into the arteries. Thus, as long as the heart is functioning normally, it acts as an automaton, responding to the demands of the tissues. The heart, however, often needs help in the form of special nerve signals to make it pump the required amounts of blood flow. 3. _Arterial pressure regulation is generally independent of either local blood flow control or cardiac output control._ The circulatory system is provided with an extensive system for controlling the arterial blood pressure. For example, if at any time the pressure falls significantly below the normal level of about 100 mm Hg, a barrage of nervous reflexes elicits a series of circulatory changes to raise the pressure back toward normal within seconds. The nervous signals especially do the following: (a) increase the force of heart pumping; (b) cause contraction of the large venous reservoirs to provide more blood to the heart; and (c) cause generalized constric tion of the arterioles in many tissues so that more blood accumulates in the large arteries to increase the arterial pressure. Then, over more prolonged periods—hours and days—the kidneys play an ad ditional major role in pressure control by secret ing pressure-controlling hormones and regulating blood volume. Thus, the needs of the individual tissues are served specifically by the circulation. In the remainder of this chapter, we begin to discuss the basic control of tissue blood flow, cardiac output, and arterial pressure.
INTERRELATIONSHIPS OF PRESSURE, FLOW, AND RESISTANCE

Blood flow through a blood vessel is determined by two factors: (1) _pressure difference_ of the blood between the two ends of the vessel, also sometimes called the _pressure gradient_ along the vessel, which pushes the blood through the vessel; and (2) the impediment to blood flow through the vessel, which is called _vascular resistance._ **Figure 14-3** demonstrates these relationships, showing a blood vessel segment located anywhere in the circulatory system.

P1 represents the pressure at the origin of the vessel and P2 is the pressure at the other end. Resistance occurs as a result of friction between the flowing blood and the intravascular endothelium all along the inside of the ves sel. The flow through the vessel can be calculated by the following formula, which is called _Ohm’s law_:

in which F is blood flow, ΔP is the pressure difference (P1 − P2) between the two ends of the vessel, and R is the resis tance. This formula states that the blood flow is directly proportional to the pressure difference but inversely pro portional to the resistance.

Note that it is the _difference_ in pressure between the two ends of the vessel, not the absolute pressure in the vessel, that determines flow rate. For example, if the pres sure at both ends of a vessel is 100 mm Hg and no differ ence exists between the two ends, there will be no flow, despite the presence of 100 mm Hg pressure.

Ohm’s law, illustrated in the preceding formula, expresses one of the most important of all the relation ships that the reader needs to understand to compre hend the hemodynamics of the circulation. Blood flow rate means the quantity of blood that passes a given point in the circulation in a given period of time.
Ordinarily, blood flow is expressed in _milliliters per minute_ or _liters per minute,_ but it can be expressed in milliliters per second or in any other units of flow and time.

The overall blood flow in the total circulation of an adult person at rest is about 5000 ml/min. This is called the _cardiac output_ because it is the amount of blood pumped into the aorta by the heart each minute.
Many mechanical and mechanoelectrical _flowmeter_ devices can be inserted in se ries with a blood vessel or, in some cases, applied to the outside of the vessel to measure blood flow.
full.lead: Methods for Measuring Blood Flow.

full.text: An electromagnetic flow meter, the principles of which are illustrated in **Figure 14-4**, can be used to measure blood flow experimentally without opening the blood vessel. **Figure 14-4**_A_ shows the generation of electromotive force (electrical voltage) in a wire that is moved rapidly in a cross-wise direction through a magnetic field. This is the well-known princi ple for production of electricity by the electric generator. **Figure 14-4**_B_ shows that the same principle applies for generation of electromotive force in blood that is mov ing through a magnetic field. In this case, a blood vessel is placed between the poles of a strong magnet, and elec trodes are placed on the two sides of the vessel perpen dicular to the magnetic lines of force. When blood flows through the vessel, an electrical voltage proportional to the rate of blood flow is generated between the two electrodes, and this voltage is recorded using an appropriate voltmeter or electronic recording apparatus. **Figure 14-4**_C_ shows an actual probe that is placed on a large blood vessel to record its blood flow. The probe contains both the strong magnet and the electrodes.
full.lead: Electromagnetic Flowmeter.

full.text: A special advantage of the electromagnetic flowmeter is that it can record changes in flow in less than 1/100 of a second, allowing for the accurate recording of pulsatile changes in flow, as well as steady flow.

Another type of flow meter that can be applied to the outside of the vessel and that has many of the same advantages as the electro magnetic flowmeter is the _ultrasonic Doppler flowmeter,_ shown in **Figure 14-5**. A minute piezoelectric crystal is mounted at one end in the wall of the device. This crystal, when energized with an appropriate electronic apparatus, transmits ultrasound at a frequency of several hundred thousand cycles per second downstream along the flow ing blood. A portion of the sound is reflected by the red blood cells in the flowing blood. The reflected ultrasound waves then travel backward from the blood cells toward the crystal. These reflected waves have a lower frequency than the transmitted wave because the red blood cells are moving away from the transmitter crystal. This effect is called the _Doppler effect._ (It is the same effect that one experiences when a train approaches and passes by while blowing its whistle. Once the whistle has passed by the person, the pitch of the sound from the whistle suddenly becomes much lower than when the train is approaching.)
full.lead: Ultrasonic Doppler Flowmeter.

full.text: For the flowmeter shown in **Figure 14-5**, the highfrequency ultrasound wave is intermittently cut off, and the reflected wave is received back onto the crystal and greatly amplified by the electronic apparatus. Another portion of the electronic apparatus determines the frequency difference between the transmitted wave and the reflected wave, thus determining the velocity of blood flow. As long as the diam eter of a blood vessel does not change, changes in blood flow in the vessel are directly related to changes in flow velocity.
Like the electromagnetic flowmeter, the ultrasonic Doppler flowmeter is capable of recording rapid pulsatile changes in flow, as well as steady flow.

When blood flows at a steady rate through a long smooth blood vessel, it flows in _streamlines,_ with each layer of blood remaining the same distance from the vessel wall. Also, the centralmost portion of the blood stays in the center of the vessel. This type of flow is called _laminar flow_ or _streamline flow,_ in contrast to _turbulent flow,_ which is blood flowing in all directions in the vessel and continually mixing in the ves sel, as discussed subsequently.
full.lead: Laminar Flow of Blood in Vessels.

full.text: When laminar flow occurs, the velocity of flow in the center of the vessel is far greater than that toward the outer edges. This phenomenon is demonstrated in **Figure 14-6**. In **Figure 14-6A**, a vessel contains two fluids, the one at the left colored by a dye and the one at the right a clear fluid, but there is no flow in the vessel. When the fluids are made to flow, a parabolic interface develops between them, as shown 1 second later in **Figure 14-6B**. The portion of fluid adjacent to the vessel wall has hardly moved, the portion slightly away from the wall has moved a small distance, and the portion in the center of the vessel has moved a long distance. This effect is called the _parabolic profile for velocity of blood flow._
full.lead: Parabolic Velocity Profile During Laminar Flow.

full.text: The cause of the parabolic profile is as follows. The fluid molecules touching the wall move slowly because of adherence to the vessel wall. The next layer of mol ecules slips over these, the third layer over the second, the fourth layer over the third, and so forth. Therefore, the fluid in the middle of the vessel can move rapidly because many layers of slipping molecules exist between the middle of the vessel and the vessel wall. Thus, each layer toward the center flows progressively more rapidly than the outer layers.

When the rate of blood flow becomes too great, when it passes by an obstruction in a vessel, when it makes a sharp turn, or when it passes over a rough surface, the flow may then become _turbulent,_ or disorderly, rather than stream lined (**Figure 14-6C**). Turbulent flow means that the blood flows crosswise in the vessel and along the vessel, usually forming whorls in the blood, called _eddy currents._ These eddy currents are similar to the whirlpools that can be seen in a rapidly flowing river at a point of obstruction. When eddy currents are present, the blood flows with much greater resistance than when the flow is streamlined because eddies add to the overall friction of flow in the vessel tremendously.
full.lead: Turbulent Flow of Blood Under Some Conditions.

full.text: The tendency for turbulent flow increases in direct pro portion to the velocity of blood flow, the diameter of the blood vessel, and the density of the blood and is inversely proportional to the viscosity of the blood, in accordance with the following equation:

where _Re_ is _Reynolds’ number_, the measure of the ten dency for turbulence to occur, _v_ is the mean velocity of blood flow (in cm/sec), _d_ is the vessel diameter (in centi meters), ρ is density (in grams/ml), and _η_ is the viscosity (in poise). The viscosity of blood is normally about 1/30 poise, and the density is only slightly greater than 1. When Reynolds’ number rises above 200 to 400, turbulent flow will occur at some branches of vessels but will die out along the smooth portions of the vessels. However, when Reynolds’ number rises above approximately 2000, turbu lence will usually occur, even in a straight, smooth vessel.

Reynolds’ number for flow in the vascular system normally rises to 200 to 400, even in large arteries. As a result, there is almost always some flow turbulence at the branches of these vessels. In the proximal portions of the aorta and pulmonary artery, Reynolds’ number can rise to several thousand during the rapid phase of ejection by the ventricles, which causes considerable turbulence in the proximal aorta and pulmonary artery, where many conditions are appropriate for turbulence, such as the fol lowing: (1) high velocity of blood flow; (2) pulsatile nature of the flow; (3) sudden change in vessel diameter; and (4) large vessel diameter. However, in small vessels, Reynolds’ number is almost never high enough to cause turbulence.

Blood pressure almost al ways is measured in millimeters of mercury (mm Hg) because the mercury manometer has been used as the standard reference for measuring pressure since its inven tion in 1846 by Poiseuille. Actually, blood pressure means the _force exerted by the blood against any unit area of the vessel wall_. If the pressure in a vessel is 100 mm Hg, this means that the force exerted is sufficient to push a col umn of mercury against gravity up to a level 50 millim eters high.
full.lead: Standard Units of Pressure.

full.text: Occasionally, pressure is measured in _centimeters of water_ (cm H2O). A pressure of 10 cm H2O means a pres sure sufficient to raise a column of water against gravity to a height of 10 centimeters. _One millimeter of mercury pressure equals 1.36 centimeters of water pressure_ because the specific gravity of mercury is 13.6 times that of water, and 1 centimeter is 10 times as great as 1 millimeter.

The mercury in a manometer has so much inertia that it cannot rise and fall rapidly. For this reason, the mercury manometer, although excellent for recording steady pres sures, cannot respond to pressure changes that occur more rapidly than about one cycle every 2 to 3 seconds. When ever it is desired to record rapidly changing pressures, some other type of pressure recorder is necessary. **Figure 14-7** demonstrates the basic principles of three electronic pressure _transducers_ commonly used for converting blood pressure and/ or rapid changes in pressure into electrical signals and then recording the electrical signals on a high-speed electrical record er. Each of these transducers uses a very thin, highly stretched metal membrane that forms one wall of the fluid chamber. The fluid chamber, in turn, is connected through a needle or cath eter inserted into the blood vessel in which the pressure is to be measured. When the pressure is high, the membrane bulges slightly and, when it is low, it returns toward its resting position.
full.lead: High-Fidelity Methods for Measuring Blood Pressure.

full.text: In **Figure 14-7A**, a simple metal plate is placed a few hundredths of a centimeter above the membrane. When the membrane bulges, the membrane comes closer to the plate, which increases the _electrical capacitance_ between these two, and this change in capacitance can be recorded using an appropriate electronic system.

In **Figure 14-7B**, a small iron slug rests on the mem brane, and this slug can be displaced upward into a center space inside an electrical wire coil. Movement of the iron into the coil increases the _inductance_ of the coil, and this too can be recorded electronically.

Finally, in **Figure 14-7C**, a very thin, stretched resist ance wire is connected to the membrane. When this wire is stretched greatly, its resistance increases; when it is stretched less, its resistance decreases. These changes can also be recorded by an electronic system.

The electrical signals from the transducer are sent to an amplifier and then to an appropriate recording device. With some of these high-fidelity types of recording systems, pres sure cycles up to 500 cycles/sec have been recorded accu rately. In common use are recorders capable of registering pressure changes that occur as rapidly as 20 to 100 cycles/ sec in the manner shown on the recorder in **Figure 14-7C**.
RESISTANCE TO BLOOD FLOW

Resistance is the impediment to blood flow in a vessel, but it cannot be measured by any direct means. Instead, resistance must be calculated from measurements of blood flow and pressure difference be tween two points in the vessel. If the pressure difference between two points is 1 mm Hg and the flow is 1 ml/sec, the resistance is said to be _1 peripheral resistance unit,_ usually abbreviated _PRU_.

full.text: Total Peripheral Vascular Resistance and Total Pul monary Vascular Resistance. The rate of blood flow through the entire circulatory system is equal to the rate of blood pumping by the heart—that is, it is equal to the cardiac output. In an adult human, this averages approx imately 100 ml/sec. The pressure difference from the systemic arteries to the systemic veins is about 100 mm Hg. Therefore, the resistance of the entire systemic cir culation, called the _total peripheral resistance,_ is about 100/100, or 1 PRU. In conditions in which all the blood vessels throughout the body become strongly constricted, the total periph eral resistance occasionally rises to as high as 4 PRU. Conversely, when the vessels become greatly dilated, the resistance can fall to as little as 0.2 PRU.

In the pulmonary system, the mean pulmonary arterial pressure averages 16 mm Hg and the mean left atrial pres sure averages 2 mm Hg, giving a net pressure difference of 14 mm. Therefore, when the cardiac output is normal at about 100 ml/sec, the _total pulmonary vascular resistance_ calculates to be about 0.14 PRU (about one seventh that in the systemic circulation).

Conductance is a measure of the blood flow through a vessel for a given pressure difference. This measurement is generally expressed in terms of ml/sec per mm Hg pressure, but it can also be expressed in terms of L/sec per mm Hg or in any other units of blood flow and pressure.

This phenom enon is illustrated in **Figure 14-8A**, which shows three ves sels with relative diameters of 1, 2, and 4 but with the same pressure difference of 100 mm Hg between the two ends of the vessels. Although the diameters of these vessels increase only fourfold, the respective flows are 1, 16, and 256 ml/ min, which is a 256-fold increase in flow. Thus, the conduct ance of the vessel increases in proportion to the _fourth pow er of the diameter,_ in accordance with the following formula:

full.text: Poiseuille’s Law. The cause of this great increase in con ductance when the diameter increases can be explained by referring to **Figure 14-8B**, which shows cross sections of a large and small vessel. The concentric rings inside the vessels indicate that the velocity of flow in each ring is different from that in the adjacent rings because of _lami nar_ flow, which was discussed earlier in the chapter. That is, the blood in the ring touching the wall of the vessel is barely flowing because of its adherence to the vascular en dothelium. The next ring of blood toward the center of the vessel slips past the first ring and, therefore, flows more rapidly. Likewise, the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth rings flow at progressively increasing velocities. Thus, the blood that is near the wall of the vessel flows slowly, whereas that in the middle of the vessel flows much more rapidly.

In the small vessel, essentially all the blood is near the wall, so the extremely rapidly flowing central stream of blood simply does not exist. By integrating the velocities of all the concentric rings of flowing blood and multiply ing them by the areas of the rings, one can derive the fol lowing formula, known as _Poiseuille’s law_:
in which F is the rate of blood flow, ΔP is the pressure dif ference between the ends of the vessel, r is the radius of the vessel, l is length of the vessel, and η is viscosity of the blood.

Note particularly in this equation that the rate of blood flow is directly proportional to the _fourth power of the radius_ of the vessel, which demonstrates once again that the diameter of a blood vessel (which is equal to twice the radius) plays the greatest role of all factors in determining the rate of blood flow through a vessel.

In the systemic circulation, about two thirds of the total sys temic resistance to blood flow is resistance in the small arterioles. The internal diameters of the arterioles range from as little as 4 micrometers to as much as 25 mi crometers. However, their strong vascular walls allow the internal diameters to change tremendously, often as much as fourfold. From the fourth power law discussed earlier, which relates blood flow to diameter of the ves sel, one can see that a fourfold increase in vessel diam eter can increase the flow as much as 256-fold. Thus, this fourth power law makes it possible for the arteri oles, responding with only small changes in diameter to nervous signals or local tissue chemical signals, either to turn off the blood flow to the tissue almost completely or, at the other extreme, to cause a vast increase in flow. Ranges of blood flow of more than 100-fold in separate tissue areas have been recorded between the limits of maximum arteriolar constriction and maximum arteri olar dilation.
full.lead: Importance of the Vessel Diameter Fourth Power Law in Determining Arteriolar Resistance.

full.text: Blood pumped by the heart flows from the high-pressure part of the systemic circulation (i.e., aorta) to the low-pressure side (i.e., vena cava) through many miles of blood vessels arranged in series and in parallel. The arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, and veins are collectively arranged in series. When blood vessels are arranged in series, flow through each blood vessel is the same, and the total resistance to blood flow (Rtotal) is equal to the sum of the resistances of each vessel:
full.lead: Resistance to Blood Flow in Series and Parallel Vascular Circuits.

full.text: The total peripheral vascular resistance is therefore equal to the sum of resistances of the arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, and veins. In the example shown in **Figure 14-9A**, the total vascular resistance is equal to the sum of R1 and R2.

Blood vessels branch extensively to form parallel cir cuits that supply blood to the many organs and tissues of the body. This parallel arrangement permits each tissue to regulate its own blood flow, to a great extent, indepen dently of flow to other tissues.
For blood vessels arranged in parallel (**Figure 14-9B**), the total resistance to blood flow is expressed as follows:

It is obvious that for a given pressure gradient, far greater amounts of blood will flow through this parallel system than through any of the individual blood vessels. Therefore, the total resistance is far less than the resis tance of any single blood vessel. Flow through each of the parallel vessels in **Figure 14-9B** is determined by the pres sure gradient and its own resistance, not the resistance of the other parallel blood vessels. However, increasing the resistance of any of the blood vessels increases the total vascular resistance.

It may seem paradoxical that adding more blood ves sels to a circuit reduces the total vascular resistance. Many parallel blood vessels, however, make it easier for blood to flow through the circuit because each parallel vessel pro vides another pathway, or _conductance,_ for blood flow. The total conductance (Ctotal) for blood flow is the sum of the conductance of each parallel pathway:

For example, brain, kidney, muscle, gastrointestinal, skin, and coronary circulations are arranged in parallel, and each tissue contributes to the overall conductance of the systemic circulation. Blood flow through each tissue is a fraction of the total blood flow (cardiac out put) and is determined by the resistance (the reciprocal of conductance) for blood flow in the tissue, as well as the pressure gradient. Therefore, amputation of a limb or surgical removal of a kidney also removes a parallel cir cuit and reduces the total vascular conductance and total blood flow (i.e., cardiac output) while increasing the total peripheral vascular resistance.
Effect of Blood Hematocrit and Blood Viscosity on Vascular Resistance and Blood Flow

Note that another important factor in Poiseuille’s equa tion is the viscosity of the blood. The greater the viscosity, the lower the flow in a vessel if all other factors are con stant. Furthermore, _the viscosity of normal blood is about three times as great as the viscosity of water._

What makes the blood so viscous? It is mainly the large numbers of suspended red cells in the blood, each of which exerts frictional drag against adjacent cells and against the wall of the blood vessel.

If a person has a hematocrit of 40, this means that 40% of the blood volume is cells, and the remainder is plasma. The hematocrit of adult men aver ages about 42, whereas that of women averages about 38. These values can vary greatly, depending on wheth er the person has anemia, the degree of bodily activ ity, and the altitude at which the person resides. These changes in hematocrit are discussed in relationship to the red blood cells and their oxygen transport function in Chapter 33.
full.lead: Hematocrit—the Proportion of Blood That Is Red Blood Cells.

full.text: Hematocrit is determined by centrifuging blood in a calibrated tube, as shown in **Figure 14-10**. The calibra tion allows direct reading of the percentage of cells.

The viscosity of blood increases markedly as the hematocrit increases, as shown in **Figure 14-11**. The vis cosity of whole blood at a normal hematocrit is about 3 to 4, which means that three to four times as much pressure is required to force whole blood as to force water through the same blood vessel. When the hematocrit rises to 60 or 70, which it often does in persons with _polycythemia,_ the blood viscosity can become as great as 10 times that of water, and its flow through blood vessels is greatly re tarded.
full.lead: Increasing Hematocrit Markedly Increases Blood Viscosity.

full.text: Other factors that affect blood viscosity are the plasma protein concentration and types of proteins in the plasma, but these effects are so much less than the effect of hematocrit that they are not significant considerations in most hemodynamic studies. The viscosity of blood plasma is about 1.5 times that of water.
EFFECTS OF PRESSURE ON VASCULAR RESISTANCE AND TISSUE BLOOD FLOW

From the discussion thus far, one might expect an increase in arterial pres sure to cause a proportionate increase in blood flow through the body’s tissues. However, the effect of arte rial pressure on blood flow in many tissues is usually far less than one might expect, as shown in **Figure 14-12**. This is because an increase in arterial pressure not only increases the force that pushes blood through the ves sels, but also initiates compensatory increases in vascu lar resistance within a few seconds through activation of the local control mechanisms, discussed in Chapter 17. Conversely, with reductions in arterial pressure, vascular resistance is promptly reduced in most tissues, and blood flow is maintained at a relatively constant rate. The abil ity of each tissue to adjust its vascular resistance and to maintain normal blood flow during changes in arterial pressure between approximately 70 and 175 mm Hg is called _blood flow autoregulation._
full.lead: Autoregulation Attenuates the Effect of Arterial Pressure on Tissue Blood Flow.

full.text: Note in **Figure 14-12** that changes in blood flow can be caused by strong sympathetic stimulation, which _constricts_ the blood vessels. Likewise, hormonal vaso constrictors, such as _norepinephrine, angiotensin II, vaso pressin,_ or _endothelin,_ can also reduce blood flow, at least transiently.

Blood flow changes rarely last for more than a few hours in most tissues, even when increases in arterial pressure or increased levels of vasoconstrictors are sustained. The reason for the relative constancy of blood flow is that each tissue’s local autoregulatory mechanisms eventually over ride most of the effects of vasoconstrictors to provide a blood flow that is appropriate for the needs of the tissue.

In isolated blood vessels or in tissues that do not exhibit autoregulation, changes in arterial pressure may have important effects on blood flow. The effect of pressure on blood flow may be greater than that predicted by Poi seuille’s equation, as shown by the upward curving lines in **Figure 14-13**. The reason for this is that increased ar terial pressure not only increases the force that pushes blood through the vessels, but also distends the elastic vessels, actually _decreasing_ vascular resistance. Con versely, decreased arterial pressure in passive blood ves sels increases resistance as the elastic vessels gradually collapse due to reduced distending pressure. When pres sure falls below a critical level, called the _critical closing pressure,_ flow ceases because the blood vessels are com pletely collapsed.
full.lead: Pressure-Flow Relationship in Passive Vascular Beds.

full.text: Sympathetic stimulation and other vasoconstrictors can alter the passive pressure-flow relationship shown in **Figure 14-13**. Thus, _inhibition of_ sympathetic activity _greatly dilates_ the vessels and can increase the blood flow twofold or more. Conversely, very strong sympathetic stimulation _can constrict_ the vessels so much that blood flow occasionally decreases to as low as zero for a few sec onds, despite high arterial pressure.

In reality, there are few physiological conditions in which tissues display the passive pressure-flow relation ship shown in **Figure 14-13**. Even in tissues that do not effectively autoregulate blood flow during acute changes in arterial pressure, blood flow is regulated according to the needs of the tissue when the pressure changes are sus tained, as discussed in Chapter 17.

Tension on the blood vessel wall develops in response to transmural pressure gradients and causes vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells to stretch in all directions (**Figure 14-14A**). According to the _law of Laplace_, wall tension (T) for a thin-walled tube is proportional to the transmural pressure gradient (ΔP) times the radius (_r_) of the blood vessel divided by its wall thickness (h):
full.lead: Vascular Wall Tension.

full.text: Thus, larger blood vessels exposed to high pressures, such as the aorta, must have stronger walls to withstand higher levels of tension and are generally reinforced with fibrous bands of collagen. In contrast, capillaries have a much smaller radii and therefore are exposed to much lower wall tension, permitting them to withstand pres sures as high as 65 to 70 mm Hg in some organs such as the kidneys. As discussed in Chapter 17, chronic changes in blood pressure lead to remodeling of blood vessels to accommodate the associated changes in wall tension.

As blood flows it creates a fric tional force, or drag, on the endothelial cells lining the blood vessels (see **Figure 14-14B**). This force, called _shear stress_, is proportional to the flow velocity and viscosity of the blood, inversely related to the radius cubed, and gen erally is expressed in force/unit area (e.g., dynes/cm2). In clinical practice, there is no single commonly used meth od for measuring shear stress. However, despite its rela tively low magnitude compared to contractile forces or wall stretch from blood pressure, shear stress is important in the development and adaptation of the vascular system to accommodate the blood flow requirements of the tis sues. Endothelial cells contain multiple proteins that to gether serve as mechanical sensors and regulate signaling pathways that shape the vasculature during embryonic development and continue altering blood vessel morphol ogy to optimize delivery of blood to tissues in adult life, as discussed further in Chapter 17.

ch14-f0.text: Qon aylanişining vazifasi — tana töqimalarining ehtiyojlariga xizmat qiliş: töqimalarga oziq moddalarni yetkaziş, çiqindi mahsulotlarni olib ketiş, gormonlarni tananing bir qismidan boşqasiga taşiş va, umuman olganda, hujayralarning yaşaşi va eng yaxşi işlaşi uçun barça töqima suyuqliklarida tegişli muhitni saqlab turiş.

ch14-f1.text: Köplab töqimalar orqali ötadigan qon oqimi tezligi asosan ularning oziq moddalarga bölgan ehtiyoji va metabolizm çiqindi mahsulotlarini çiqarib yuboriş zaruratiga javoban boşqariladi. Buyraklar kabi ba’zi a’zolarda qon aylanişi qöşimça vazifalarni ham bajaradi. Masalan, buyrakka keladigan qon oqimi uning metabolik ehtiyojlaridan ança ortiq bölib, uning ajratiş funksiyasi bilan boğliq: bu funksiya har daqiqada katta hajmdagi qonning filtrlanişini talab qiladi.

ch14-f2.text: Yurak va qon tomirlar esa, öz navbatida, töqimalarni yetarli qon oqimi bilan ta’minlaş uçun zarur bölgan yurak çiqarişi (yurakning daqiqalik hajmi) va arterial bosimni ta’minlaydigan tarzda boşqariladi. Qon hajmi va qon oqimini boşqariş mexanizmlari qanday va bu jarayon qon aylanişining boşqa funksiyalari bilan qanday boğliq? Qon aylanişiga bağişlangan uşbu bölimda muhokama qilinadigan mavzu va savollarning ba’zilari şulardir.

ch14-f4.text: **Rasm 14-1** da körsatilgan qon aylanişi _katta (sistemali) qon aylanişi_ va _kiçik (öpka) qon aylanişiga_ bölinadi. Sistemali qon aylanişi öpkadan taşqari tananing barça töqimalarini qon bilan ta’minlagani uçun u _katta qon aylaniş doirasi_ yoki _periferik qon aylanişi_ deb ham ataladi.

ch14-f6.text: Qon aylanişi funksiyasining tafsilotlarini muhokama qilişdan oldin qon aylanişining har bir qismi qanday rol öynaşini tuşunib oliş muhim.

ch14-f7.text: _Arteriyalarning_ vazifasi — qonni _yuqori bosim ostida_ töqimalarga yetkaziş. Şu sababli arteriyalarning tomir devorlari mustahkam böladi va arteriyalarda qon yuqori tezlikda oqadi.

ch14-f8.text: _Arteriolalar_ — arterial tizimning eng oxirgi mayda tarmoqlari; ular qon kapillyarlarga çiqariladigan _boşqaruvçi kanallar_ vazifasini bajaradi. Arteriolalarning muskul devorlari kuçli bölib, ular arteriolalarni butunlay yopib qöyişi yoki böşaşib, tomirlarni bir neça barobar kengaytirişi mumkin; şunday qilib, arteriolalar har bir töqimadagi qon oqimini uning ehtiyojlariga javoban keskin özgartira oladi.

ch14-f9.text: _Kapillyarlarning_ vazifasi — qon va interstitsial suyuqlik örtasida suyuqlik, oziq moddalar, elektrolitlar, gormonlar va boşqa moddalar almaşinuvini ta’minlaş. Bu vazifani bajariş uçun kapillyar devorlari yupqa bölib, ularda suv va boşqa kiçik molekulali moddalarni ötkazadigan köplab mayda _kapillyar teşikçalar (poralar)_ bor.

ch14-f10.text: _Venulalar_ kapillyarlardan qonni yiğadi va asta-sekin qöşilib, tobora yirikroq venalarni hosil qiladi.

ch14-f11.text: _Venalar_ qonni venulalardan yurakka qaytarib olib boruvçi kanallar vazifasini bajaradi. Venalar, şuningdek, ortiqça qonning asosiy zaxirasi (rezervuari) bölib xizmat qiladi. Vena tizimida bosim past bölgani uçun vena devorlari yupqa. Şunga qaramay, ular qisqarişi yoki kengayişi uçun yetarliça muskulga ega va şu tufayli qon aylanişining ehtiyojlariga qarab ortiqça qonning oz yoki köp miqdori uçun boşqariladigan zaxira vazifasini bajaradi.

ch14-f12.text: **Rasm 14-1** da qon aylanişining umumiy körinişi berilgan va qon aylanişining asosiy bölimlaridagi qon hajmining umumiy qon hajmiga nisbatan foizlari körsatilgan. Masalan, tanadagi butun qon hajmining taxminan 84% i sistemali qon aylanişida, 16% i esa yurak va öpkada joylaşgan. Sistemali qon aylanişidagi 84% ning taxminan 64% i venalarda, 13% i arteriyalarda, 7% i esa sistemali arteriolalar va kapillyarlarda böladi. Yurakda qonning 7% i, öpka tomirlarida esa 9% i böladi.
ch14-f12.lead: Qon aylanişining turli qismlaridagi qon hajmlari.

ch14-f13.text: Eng ajablanarlisi — kapillyarlardagi qon hajmining kamligi. Biroq 16-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, qon aylanişining eng muhim vazifasi — moddalarning qon va töqimalar örtasida u yoqdan-bu yoqqa diffuziyalanişi aynan şu yerda sodir böladi.

ch14-f14.text: Agar har bir turdagi barça _sistemali tomirlar_ yonma-yon qöyilsa, örtaça odamda ularning taxminiy umumiy köndalang kesim yuzalari quyidagiça böladi:
ch14-f14.lead: Köndalang kesim yuzalari va qon oqimi tezliklari.

ch14-f15.text: Ayniqsa e’tibor beringki, venalarning köndalang kesim yuzalari arteriyalarnikidan ança katta bölib, örtaça tegişli arteriyalarnikidan taxminan tört barobar katta. Bu farq vena tizimining arterial tizimga nisbatan qonni saqlaş siğimi kattaligini tuşuntiradi.

ch14-f16.text: Qon aylanişining har bir bölimidan har daqiqada bir xil hajmdagi qon oqimi (F) ötişi kerak bölgani sababli, qon oqimi tezligi (v) tomirlarning köndalang kesim yuzasiga (A) teskari proporsional:

ch14-f17.text: Şunday qilib, tinç holatda qon oqimi tezligi aortada örtaça taxminan 33 sm/s ni taşkil etadi, kapillyarlarda esa atigi 1/1000 qismiça — taxminan 0,3 mm/s. Biroq kapillyarlarning odatiy uzunligi atigi 0,3–1 millimetr bölgani uçun qon kapillyarlarda atigi 1–3 soniya qoladi; bu hayratlanarli, çunki kapillyar devorlari orqali sodir böladigan oziq moddalar va elektrolitlarning barça diffuziyasi aynan şu qisqa vaqt içida amalga oşişi kerak.

ch14-f18.text: Yurak qonni aortaga uzluksiz haydab turgani sababli aortadagi örtaça bosim yuqori bölib, örtaça taxminan 100 mm Hg ni taşkil etadi. Şuningdek, yurakning nasos faoliyati pulsatsiyali (zarbli) bölgani uçun, **Rasm 14-2** ning çap tomonida körsatilganidek, tinç holatda arterial bosim odatda örtaça 120 mm Hg li _sistolik bosim darajasi_ va 80 mm Hg li _diastolik bosim darajasi_ örtasida özgarib turadi.

ch14-f20.text: Qon _sistemali qon aylanişi_ böylab oqar ekan, uning örtaça bosimi asta-sekin pasayib boradi va yuqori hamda pastki kovak venalarning yurakning öng bölmaçasiga quyiladigan oxirgi qismiga yetganda taxminan 0 mm Hg gaça tuşadi.

ch14-f21.text: Köplab sistemali kapillyarlardagi bosim arteriola uçlari yaqinida 35 mm Hg gaça yuqori, vena uçlari yaqinida esa 10 mm Hg gaça past böladi, biroq köpçilik tomir törlarida ularning örtaça funksional bosimi taxminan 17 mm Hg ni taşkil etadi. Bu bosim şunçalik pastki, kapillyar devorlaridagi mayda _teşikçalar_ orqali plazmaning oz qismigina sizib çiqadi, holbuki oziq moddalar xuddi şu teşikçalar orqali atrofdagi töqima hujayralariga oson _diffuziyalana_ oladi. Ba’zi kapillyarlarda, masalan, buyraklarning koptokça kapillyarlarida bosim ança yuqori bölib, örtaça taxminan 60 mm Hg ni taşkil etadi va suyuqlik filtrlanişining ança yuqori tezligini ta’minlaydi.

ch14-f22.text: **Rasm 14-2** ning eng öng tomonida _kiçik (öpka) qon aylanişining_ turli qismlaridagi tegişli bosimlarga e’tibor bering. Öpka arteriyalarida bosim xuddi aortadagi kabi pulsatsiyali, ammo ança past: _öpka arteriyasidagi sistolik bosim_ örtaça taxminan 25 mm Hg, _diastolik bosim_ esa örtaça taxminan 8 mm Hg bölib, öpka arteriyasidagi örtaça bosim atigi 16 mm Hg ni taşkil etadi. Öpka kapillyarlaridagi örtaça bosim esa örtaça atigi 7 mm Hg ga teng. Şunga qaramay, har daqiqada öpka orqali ötadigan umumiy qon oqimi sistemali qon aylanişidagi bilan bir xil. Öpka tizimidagi bosimlarning pastligi öpkaning ehtiyojlariga mos keladi, çunki bu yerda faqat öpka kapillyarlaridagi qonni öpka alveolalaridagi kislorod va boşqa gazlar bilan töqnaştiriş talab qilinadi.

ch14-f24.text: Qon aylanişi funksiyasining tafsilotlari murakkab bölsa-da, tizimning barça funksiyalari uçta asosiy tamoyilga asoslanadi. 1. _Köpçilik töqimalardagi qon oqimi töqima ehtiyojlariga muvofiq boşqariladi._ Töqimalar faol bölganda ularga oziq moddalar köproq yetkazilişi va şuning uçun tinç holatdagiga qaraganda köproq qon oqimi kerak böladi, ba’zan tinç holatdagi darajadan 20–30 baravargaça köp. Biroq yurak odatda yurak çiqarişini tinç holatdagi darajadan tört-yetti baravardan ortiq oşira olmaydi. Şuning uçun biror töqima qon oqimining ortişini talab qilganda tananing hamma joyida qon oqimini şunçaki oşirib bölmaydi. Buning örniga har bir töqimaning mikrotomirlari, ayniqsa arteriolalar, töqima ehtiyojlarini — masalan, kislorod va boşqa oziq moddalarning mavjudligini hamda karbonat angidrid va boşqa töqima çiqindi mahsulotlarining töplanişini — uzluksiz kuzatib boradi. Bu mikrotomirlar, öz navbatida, mahalliy qon oqimini töqima faolligi uçun zarur darajada uşlab turiş maqsadida kengayadi yoki torayadi. Şuningdek, markaziy nerv tizimi tomonidan qon aylanişining nerv orqali boşqarilişi va gormonlar töqima qon oqimini boşqarişda qöşimça yordam beradi.

ch14-f25.text: 2. _Yurak çiqarişi — barça mahalliy töqima qon oqimlarining yiğindisi._ Qon töqima orqali ötgaç, darhol venalar orqali yurakka qaytadi. Yurak qon oqimining bu tarzda köpayişiga avtomatik ravişda javob beradi va uni darhol arteriyalarga qaytarib haydaydi. Şunday qilib, yurak me’yoriy işlayotgan ekan, u töqimalar talablariga javob beruvçi avtomat kabi harakat qiladi. Biroq yurak zarur miqdordagi qonni haydaşi uçun köpinça maxsus nerv signallari körinişidagi yordamga muhtoj böladi. 3. _Arterial bosimning boşqarilişi odatda mahalliy qon oqimini boşqarişga ham, yurak çiqarişini boşqarişga ham boğliq emas._ Qon aylaniş tizimi arterial qon bosimini boşqarişning keng qamrovli tizimi bilan ta’minlangan. Masalan, agar biror vaqtda bosim taxminan 100 mm Hg li me’yoriy darajadan sezilarli pasaysa, köplab nerv reflekslari bir neça soniya içida bosimni me’yorga qaytariş uçun qon aylanişida bir qator özgarişlarni keltirib çiqaradi. Nerv signallari ayniqsa quyidagilarni amalga oşiradi: (a) yurakning nasos kuçini oşiradi; (b) yurakka köproq qon yetkaziş uçun yirik vena zaxiralarini qisqartiradi; (c) köplab töqimalardagi arteriolalarning umumiy torayişiga sabab böladi, natijada yirik arteriyalarda köproq qon töplanib, arterial bosim oşadi. Söngra uzoqroq davrlar — soatlar va kunlar davomida buyraklar bosimni boşqaruvçi gormonlarni ajratiş va qon hajmini boşqariş orqali bosimni nazorat qilişda qöşimça muhim rol öynaydi. Şunday qilib, qon aylanişi alohida töqimalarning ehtiyojlariga aniq moslaşgan holda xizmat qiladi. Uşbu bobning qolgan qismida töqima qon oqimi, yurak çiqarişi va arterial bosimning asosiy boşqarilişini muhokama qilişni boşlaymiz.

ch14-f26.text: Bosim, qon oqimi va qarşilikning özaro boğliqligi

ch14-f27.text: Qon tomiri orqali ötadigan qon oqimi ikki omil bilan belgilanadi: (1) tomirning ikki uçi orasidagi qon _bosimlari farqi_ — u ba’zan tomir böylab _bosim gradiyenti_ deb ham ataladi va qonni tomir böylab itaradi; (2) qonning tomir orqali oqişiga tösqinlik — u _tomir qarşiligi_ deb ataladi. **Rasm 14-3** da qon aylaniş tizimining istalgan joyida joylaşgan qon tomiri bölagi orqali bu boğliqliklar körsatilgan.

ch14-f29.text: P1 tomirning boşlanişidagi bosimni, P2 esa uning ikkinçi uçidagi bosimni ifodalaydi. Qarşilik oqayotgan qon bilan tomirning butun içki yuzasi böylab joylaşgan tomir içi endoteliysi örtasidagi işqalaniş natijasida yuzaga keladi. Tomir orqali ötadigan qon oqimini _Om qonuni_ deb ataladigan quyidagi formula bilan hisoblaş mumkin:

ch14-f30.text: bu yerda F — qon oqimi, ΔP — tomirning ikki uçi orasidagi bosimlar farqi (P1 − P2), R esa qarşilik. Bu formulaga köra, qon oqimi bosimlar farqiga töğri proporsional, qarşilikka esa teskari proporsional.

ch14-f31.text: E’tibor beringki, oqim tezligini tomirdagi mutlaq bosim emas, balki tomirning ikki uçi orasidagi bosim _farqi_ belgilaydi. Masalan, agar tomirning ikkala uçidagi bosim 100 mm Hg bölsa va ikki uç örtasida heç qanday farq bölmasa, 100 mm Hg bosim mavjud bölişiga qaramay, oqim bölmaydi.

ch14-f32.text: Yuqoridagi formulada ifodalangan Om qonuni öquvçi qon aylanişi gemodinamikasini anglaşi uçun tuşunişi zarur bölgan barça boğliqliklar içida eng muhimlaridan birini ifodalaydi. Bu formula öta muhim bölgani sababli öquvçi uning boşqa algebraik şakllari bilan ham tanişib çiqişi lozim:

ch14-f33.text: Qon oqimi tezligi deganda ma’lum vaqt davomida qon aylanişining ma’lum nuqtasidan ötadigan qon miqdori tuşuniladi.

ch14-f34.text: Odatda qon oqimi _millilitr/daqiqa_ yoki _litr/daqiqa_ birliklarida ifodalanadi, biroq uni millilitr/soniya yoki boşqa har qanday oqim va vaqt birliklarida ham ifodalaş mumkin.

ch14-f35.text: Tinç holatdagi katta yoşli odamda butun qon aylanişidagi umumiy qon oqimi taxminan 5000 ml/daq ni taşkil etadi. U _yurak çiqarişi_ (yurakning daqiqalik hajmi) deb ataladi, çunki bu yurak har daqiqada aortaga haydaydigan qon miqdoridir.

ch14-f36.text: Qon oqimini ölçaş uçun köplab mexanik va mexanoelektrik _oqim ölçagiç_ (flowmetr) qurilmalarini qon tomiriga ketma-ket ulaş yoki ba’zi hollarda tomirning taşqi yuzasiga qöyiş mumkin.

ch14-f37.text: Işlaş tamoyillari **Rasm 14-4** da tasvirlangan elektromagnit flowmetr yordamida qon tomirini oçmasdan turib tajribada qon oqimini ölçaş mumkin. **Rasm 14-4**_A_ da magnit maydoni orqali köndalang yönalişda tez harakatlantirilgan simda elektr yurituvçi kuç (elektr kuçlanişi) hosil bölişi körsatilgan. Bu elektr generatorida elektr energiyasi hosil qilişning yaxşi ma’lum tamoyili. **Rasm 14-4**_B_ da xuddi şu tamoyil magnit maydoni orqali harakatlanayotgan qonda elektr yurituvçi kuç hosil bölişiga ham taalluqli ekanligi körsatilgan. Bu holatda qon tomiri kuçli magnitning qutblari orasiga joylaştiriladi, elektrodlar esa tomirning ikki tomoniga magnit kuç çiziqlariga perpendikulyar qilib qöyiladi. Qon tomir orqali oqqanda ikki elektrod örtasida qon oqimi tezligiga proporsional elektr kuçlanişi hosil böladi va bu kuçlaniş tegişli voltmetr yoki elektron yozib oluvçi apparat yordamida qayd etiladi. **Rasm 14-4**_C_ da qon oqimini yozib oliş uçun yirik qon tomiriga qöyiladigan haqiqiy datçik körsatilgan. Datçik içida ham kuçli magnit, ham elektrodlar joylaşgan.

ch14-f39.text: Elektromagnit flowmetrning alohida afzalligi şundaki, u oqimdagi özgarişlarni soniyaning 1/100 qismidan kamroq vaqt içida qayd eta oladi; bu barqaror oqimni ham, oqimning pulsatsiyali özgarişlarini ham aniq yozib oliş imkonini beradi.

ch14-f40.text: Tomirning taşqi yuzasiga qöyilişi mumkin bölgan va elektromagnit flowmetrning köplab afzalliklariga ega bölgan flowmetrning yana bir turi — **Rasm 14-5** da körsatilgan _ultratovuşli Doppler flowmetr_. Qurilma devorining bir uçiga juda kiçik pyezoelektrik kristall örnatilgan. Bu kristall tegişli elektron apparat yordamida energiya bilan ta’minlanganda, oqayotgan qon böylab oqim yönalişida soniyasiga bir neça yuz ming sikl çastotali ultratovuş çiqaradi. Tovuşning bir qismi oqayotgan qondagi eritrotsitlardan qaytadi. Söngra qaytgan ultratovuş tölqinlari qon hujayralaridan kristall tomon orqaga tarqaladi. Bu qaytgan tölqinlarning çastotasi yuborilgan tölqinnikidan pastroq böladi, çunki eritrotsitlar uzatuvçi kristalldan uzoqlaşib boradi. Bu hodisa _Doppler effekti_ deb ataladi. (Bu poyezd huştak çalib yaqinlaşib kelib, yonidan ötib ketganda odam sezadigan effektning xuddi özi. Huştak odamning yonidan ötib ketgaç, huştak tovuşining balandligi poyezd yaqinlaşib kelayotgandagiga qaraganda tösatdan ança pasayadi.)

ch14-f42.text: **Rasm 14-5** da körsatilgan flowmetrda yuqori çastotali ultratovuş tölqini vaqti-vaqti bilan uzib turiladi, qaytgan tölqin esa yana kristallga qabul qilinadi va elektron apparat tomonidan kuçli darajada kuçaytiriladi. Elektron apparatning boşqa bir qismi yuborilgan tölqin va qaytgan tölqin örtasidagi çastota farqini aniqlaydi va şu orqali qon oqimi tezligini aniqlaydi. Qon tomirining diametri özgarmas ekan, tomirdagi qon oqimining özgarişlari oqim tezligining özgarişlari bilan bevosita boğliq böladi.

ch14-f43.text: Elektromagnit flowmetr kabi ultratovuşli Doppler flowmetr ham barqaror oqimni, şuningdek, oqimning tez pulsatsiyali özgarişlarini yozib olişga qodir.

ch14-f44.text: Qon uzun, silliq qon tomiri orqali barqaror tezlikda oqqanda u _oqim çiziqlari_ böylab oqadi, bunda qonning har bir qatlami tomir devoridan bir xil masofada qoladi. Şuningdek, qonning eng markaziy qismi tomir markazida qoladi. Bunday oqim _laminar oqim_ yoki _qatlamli oqim_ deb ataladi; keyinroq muhokama qilinadigan _turbulent oqim_ esa bundan farqli ölaroq, qonning tomirda barça yönalişlarda oqişi va tomir içida uzluksiz aralaşib turişidir.

ch14-f45.text: Laminar oqimda tomir markazidagi oqim tezligi taşqi çetlarga yaqin joydagidan ança yuqori böladi. Bu hodisa **Rasm 14-6** da körsatilgan. **Rasm 14-6A** da tomirda ikki xil suyuqlik bor: çapdagisi böyoq bilan böyalgan, öngdagisi esa tiniq suyuqlik, biroq tomirda oqim yöq. Suyuqliklar oqişga majbur qilinganda, **Rasm 14-6B** da 1 soniyadan keyin körsatilganidek, ular orasida parabolik çegara hosil böladi. Suyuqlikning tomir devoriga tutaşgan qismi deyarli siljimagan, devordan biroz uzoqroqdagi qismi kiçik masofaga siljigan, tomir markazidagi qismi esa uzoq masofaga siljigan. Bu effekt _qon oqimi tezligining parabolik profili_ deb ataladi.

ch14-f47.text: Parabolik profilning sababi quyidagiça. Devorga tegib turgan suyuqlik molekulalari tomir devoriga yopişişi tufayli sekin harakatlanadi. Molekulalarning keyingi qatlami bular ustidan sirpanib ötadi, uçinçi qatlam ikkinçisi ustidan, törtinçi qatlam uçinçisi ustidan va hokazo. Şuning uçun tomir örtasidagi suyuqlik tez harakatlana oladi, çunki tomir örtasi bilan tomir devori orasida sirpanuvçi molekulalarning köplab qatlamlari mavjud. Şunday qilib, markazga yaqinroq har bir qatlam taşqi qatlamlarga nisbatan tobora tezroq oqadi.

ch14-f48.text: Qon oqimi tezligi haddan taşqari oşib ketganda, qon tomirdagi tösiq yonidan ötganda, keskin buriliş qilganda yoki notekis yuza ustidan ötganda, oqim qatlamli emas, balki _turbulent_, ya’ni tartibsiz bölib qolişi mumkin (**Rasm 14-6C**). Turbulent oqim qonning tomirda ham köndalang, ham tomir böylab oqişini anglatadi; bunda qonda odatda _girdobli oqimlar_ deb ataladigan uyurmalar hosil böladi. Bu girdobli oqimlar tez oqayotgan daryoda tösiq bor joyda köriş mumkin bölgan girdoblarga öxşaydi. Girdobli oqimlar mavjud bölganda qon qatlamli oqimdagiga qaraganda ança katta qarşilik bilan oqadi, çunki girdoblar tomirdagi oqimning umumiy işqalanişini keskin oşiradi.

ch14-f49.text: Turbulent oqimga moyillik qon oqimi tezligiga, qon tomiri diametriga va qon ziçligiga töğri proporsional ravişda ortadi hamda quyidagi tenglamaga muvofiq qon qovuşqoqligiga teskari proporsionaldir:

ch14-f50.text: bu yerda _Re_ — turbulentlik yuzaga kelişiga moyillikning ölçovi bölgan _Reynolds soni_, _v_ — qon oqimining örtaça tezligi (sm/s da), _d_ — tomir diametri (santimetrda), ρ — ziçlik (g/ml da), _η_ esa qovuşqoqlik (puazda). Qonning qovuşqoqligi odatda taxminan 1/30 puaz, ziçligi esa 1 dan biroz kattaroq. Reynolds soni 200–400 dan oşganda turbulent oqim tomirlarning ba’zi tarmoqlaniş joylarida yuzaga keladi, ammo tomirlarning silliq qismlari böylab sönadi. Biroq Reynolds soni taxminan 2000 dan oşganda turbulentlik odatda hatto töğri, silliq tomirda ham yuzaga keladi.

ch14-f51.text: Tomirlar tizimidagi oqim uçun Reynolds soni odatda hatto yirik arteriyalarda ham 200–400 gaça kötariladi. Natijada bu tomirlarning tarmoqlaniş joylarida deyarli har doim oqimning ma’lum darajada turbulentligi kuzatiladi. Aorta va öpka arteriyasining proksimal qismlarida qorinçalardan qon tez haydaliş fazasida Reynolds soni bir neça minggaça kötarilişi mumkin, bu esa proksimal aorta va öpka arteriyasida sezilarli turbulentlikka sabab böladi; bu joylarda turbulentlik uçun köplab şaroitlar mavjud, masalan: (1) qon oqimining yuqori tezligi; (2) oqimning pulsatsiyali tabiati; (3) tomir diametrining keskin özgarişi; (4) tomir diametrining kattaligi. Biroq mayda tomirlarda Reynolds soni turbulentlikni keltirib çiqaradigan darajada deyarli heç qaçon yuqori bölmaydi.

ch14-f52.text: Qon bosimi deyarli har doim simob ustuni millimetrlarida (mm Hg) ölçanadi, çunki 1846-yilda Puazeyl tomonidan ixtiro qilinganidan beri simobli manometr bosimni ölçaşda standart ölçov vositasi sifatida qöllanib kelinadi. Aslida qon bosimi _qonning tomir devorining har bir birlik yuzasiga körsatadigan kuçini_ anglatadi. Agar tomirdagi bosim 100 mm Hg bölsa, bu körsatilayotgan kuç simob ustunini oğirlik kuçiga qarşi 50 millimetr balandlikkaça kötariş uçun yetarli ekanligini bildiradi.

ch14-f53.text: Ba’zan bosim _suv ustuni santimetrlarida_ (sm H2O) ölçanadi. 10 sm H2O bosim suv ustunini oğirlik kuçiga qarşi 10 santimetr balandlikkaça kötariş uçun yetarli bosimni anglatadi. _Bir millimetr simob ustuni bosimi 1,36 santimetr suv ustuni bosimiga teng_, çunki simobning soliştirma oğirligi suvnikidan 13,6 baravar katta, 1 santimetr esa 1 millimetrdan 10 baravar katta.

ch14-f54.text: Manometrdagi simob şunçalik katta inersiyaga egaki, u tez kötarilib-tuşa olmaydi. Şu sababli simobli manometr barqaror bosimlarni yozib oliş uçun a’lo darajada bölsa-da, taxminan har 2–3 soniyada bir sikldan tezroq sodir böladigan bosim özgarişlariga javob bera olmaydi. Tez özgaruvçan bosimlarni yozib oliş zarur bölganda bosimni qayd etuvçi boşqa turdagi qurilma kerak böladi. **Rasm 14-7** da qon bosimini va/yoki bosimning tez özgarişlarini elektr signallariga aylantiriş va söngra bu elektr signallarini tezkor elektr yozib oluvçi qurilmada qayd etiş uçun keng qöllaniladigan uçta elektron bosim _datçigining_ (transduserining) asosiy tamoyillari körsatilgan. Bu datçiklarning har biri suyuqlik kamerasining bir devorini taşkil etuvçi juda yupqa, kuçli tarang tortilgan metall membranadan foydalanadi. Suyuqlik kamerasi esa, öz navbatida, bosim ölçanişi kerak bölgan qon tomiriga kiritilgan igna yoki kateter orqali ulanadi. Bosim yuqori bölganda membrana biroz börtib çiqadi, past bölganda esa tinç holatiga qaytadi.
ch14-f54.lead: Qon bosimini yuqori aniqlikda ölçaş usullari.

ch14-f56.text: **Rasm 14-7A** da membranadan bir neça yuzdan bir santimetr yuqorida oddiy metall plastinka joylaştirilgan. Membrana börtganda u plastinkaga yaqinlaşadi, bu esa ular orasidagi _elektr siğimini_ oşiradi; siğimdagi bu özgarişni tegişli elektron tizim yordamida yozib oliş mumkin.

ch14-f57.text: **Rasm 14-7B** da membrana ustida kiçik temir özak turadi va bu özak yuqoriga, elektr simi ğaltagining içidagi markaziy böşliqqa siljişi mumkin. Temirning ğaltak içiga harakatlanişi ğaltakning _induktivligini_ oşiradi va buni ham elektron usulda yozib oliş mumkin.

ch14-f58.text: Nihoyat, **Rasm 14-7C** da membranaga juda ingiçka, tarang tortilgan qarşilik simi ulangan. Bu sim kuçli çözilganda uning qarşiligi ortadi, kamroq çözilganda esa qarşiligi kamayadi. Bu özgarişlarni ham elektron tizim yordamida yozib oliş mumkin.

ch14-f59.text: Datçikdan çiqqan elektr signallari kuçaytirgiçga, söngra tegişli yozib oluvçi qurilmaga yuboriladi. Ba’zi bunday yuqori aniqlikdagi yozib oliş tizimlari yordamida soniyasiga 500 siklgaça bölgan bosim sikllari aniq qayd etilgan. **Rasm 14-7C** dagi yozib oluvçi qurilmada körsatilganidek, soniyasiga 20–100 sikl tezlikda sodir böladigan bosim özgarişlarini qayd eta oladigan yozib oluvçi qurilmalar keng qöllaniladi.

ch14-f61.text: Qarşilik — tomirdagi qon oqimiga tösqinlik, ammo uni heç qanday bevosita usul bilan ölçab bölmaydi. Buning örniga qarşilik qon oqimi va tomirning ikki nuqtasi orasidagi bosimlar farqini ölçaş natijalari asosida hisoblanişi kerak. Agar ikki nuqta orasidagi bosimlar farqi 1 mm Hg, oqim esa 1 ml/s bölsa, qarşilik _1 periferik qarşilik birligiga_ teng deyiladi; u odatda _PRU_ (inglizça peripheral resistance unit) deb qisqartiriladi.

ch14-f62.text: Ba’zan qarşilikni ifodalaş uçun SGS (santimetr, gramm, soniya) birligi deb ataladigan asosiy fizik birlik qöllaniladi. Bu birlik — din·s/sm5. Bu birliklardagi qarşilikni quyidagi formula böyiça hisoblaş mumkin:

ch14-f63.text: Umumiy periferik tomir qarşiligi va umumiy öpka tomir qarşiligi. Butun qon aylaniş tizimi orqali ötadigan qon oqimi tezligi yurakning qon haydaş tezligiga, ya’ni yurak çiqarişiga teng. Katta yoşli odamda bu örtaça taxminan 100 ml/s ni taşkil etadi. Sistemali arteriyalardan sistemali venalargaça bölgan bosimlar farqi taxminan 100 mm Hg. Şuning uçun butun sistemali qon aylanişining qarşiligi — u _umumiy periferik qarşilik_ deb ataladi — taxminan 100/100, ya’ni 1 PRU ga teng. Tanadagi barça qon tomirlari kuçli torayadigan holatlarda umumiy periferik qarşilik ba’zan 4 PRU gaça kötariladi. Aksinça, tomirlar kuçli kengayganda qarşilik 0,2 PRU gaça pasayişi mumkin.

ch14-f64.text: Öpka tizimida öpka arteriyasidagi örtaça bosim örtaça 16 mm Hg, çap bölmaçadagi örtaça bosim esa örtaça 2 mm Hg bölib, sof bosimlar farqi 14 mm ni taşkil etadi. Şuning uçun yurak çiqarişi taxminan 100 ml/s lik me’yoriy darajada bölganda _umumiy öpka tomir qarşiligi_ hisob böyiça taxminan 0,14 PRU ga teng böladi (sistemali qon aylanişidagining taxminan yettidan bir qismi).

ch14-f65.text: Ötkazuvçanlik — ma’lum bosimlar farqida tomir orqali ötadigan qon oqimining ölçovi. Bu kattalik odatda 1 mm Hg bosimga töğri keladigan ml/s birliklarida ifodalanadi, biroq uni 1 mm Hg ga töğri keladigan L/s yoki qon oqimi va bosimning boşqa har qanday birliklarida ham ifodalaş mumkin.
ch14-f65.lead: Tomirdagi qon ötkazuvçanligi qarşilikka teskari kattalikdir.

ch14-f66.text: Körinib turibdiki, quyidagi tenglamaga muvofiq ötkazuvçanlik qarşilikka aynan teskari kattalikdir:

ch14-f67.text: Qon oqimi qatlamli bölganda tomir diametrining ozgina özgarişi tomirning qon ötkaziş qobiliyatini juda katta özgartiradi. Bu hodisa **Rasm 14-8A** da tasvirlangan: unda nisbiy diametrlari 1, 2 va 4 bölgan, ammo ikki uçi orasidagi bosimlar farqi bir xil — 100 mm Hg bölgan uçta tomir körsatilgan. Bu tomirlarning diametrlari atigi tört barobar ortgan bölsa-da, tegişli oqimlar 1, 16 va 256 ml/daq ni taşkil etadi, ya’ni oqim 256 barobar ortadi. Şunday qilib, quyidagi formulaga muvofiq tomirning ötkazuvçanligi _diametrning törtinçi darajasiga_ proporsional ravişda ortadi:
ch14-f67.lead: Tomir diametrining kiçik özgarişlari uning ötkazuvçanligini keskin özgartiradi.

ch14-f69.text: Puazeyl qonuni. Diametr ortganda ötkazuvçanlikning bunday katta ortişining sababini **Rasm 14-8B** yordamida tuşuntiriş mumkin; unda katta va kiçik tomirlarning köndalang kesimlari körsatilgan. Tomirlar içidagi konsentrik halqalar bobning avvalida muhokama qilingan _laminar_ oqim tufayli har bir halqadagi oqim tezligi qöşni halqalardagidan farq qilişini körsatadi. Ya’ni tomir devoriga tegib turgan halqadagi qon tomir endoteliysiga yopişganligi sababli deyarli oqmaydi. Tomir markaziga qarab keyingi qon halqasi birinçi halqa yonidan sirpanib ötadi va şuning uçun tezroq oqadi. Xuddi şunday, uçinçi, törtinçi, beşinçi va oltinçi halqalar tobora ortib boruvçi tezliklarda oqadi. Şunday qilib, tomir devori yaqinidagi qon sekin oqadi, tomir örtasidagisi esa ança tez oqadi.

ch14-f70.text: Kiçik tomirda deyarli barça qon devorga yaqin joylaşgan, şuning uçun öta tez oqadigan markaziy qon oqimi umuman mavjud bölmaydi. Oqayotgan qonning barça konsentrik halqalari tezliklarini integrallab va ularni halqalar yuzalariga köpaytirib, _Puazeyl qonuni_ deb nomlanuvçi quyidagi formulani keltirib çiqariş mumkin:

ch14-f71.text: bu yerda F — qon oqimi tezligi, ΔP — tomir uçlari orasidagi bosimlar farqi, r — tomir radiusi, l — tomir uzunligi, η esa qonning qovuşqoqligi.

ch14-f72.text: Bu tenglamada ayniqsa şunga e’tibor beringki, qon oqimi tezligi tomir _radiusining törtinçi darajasiga_ töğri proporsional; bu yana bir bor qon tomirining diametri (u radiusning ikki barobariga teng) tomir orqali ötadigan qon oqimi tezligini belgilovçi barça omillar içida eng katta rol öynaşini körsatadi.

ch14-f73.text: Sistemali qon aylanişida qon oqimiga sistemali umumiy qarşilikning taxminan uçdan ikki qismi mayda arteriolalardagi qarşilikka töğri keladi. Arteriolalarning içki diametrlari 4 mikrometrdan 25 mikrometrgaça böladi. Biroq ularning mustahkam tomir devorlari içki diametrlarning juda katta, köpinça tört barobargaça özgarişiga imkon beradi. Yuqorida muhokama qilingan, qon oqimini tomir diametri bilan boğlovçi törtinçi daraja qonunidan körinib turibdiki, tomir diametrining tört barobar ortişi oqimni 256 barobargaça oşirişi mumkin. Şunday qilib, bu törtinçi daraja qonuni nerv signallari yoki mahalliy töqima kimyoviy signallariga diametrning atigi kiçik özgarişlari bilan javob beradigan arteriolalarga töqimaga qon oqimini deyarli butunlay töxtatiş yoki, boşqa çekka holatda, oqimni juda katta darajada oşiriş imkonini beradi. Alohida töqima sohalarida arteriolalarning maksimal torayişi va maksimal kengayişi çegaralari orasida qon oqimining 100 barobardan ortiq diapazonlari qayd etilgan.
ch14-f73.lead: Arteriola qarşiligini belgilaşda tomir diametrining törtinçi daraja qonunining ahamiyati.

ch14-f74.text: Yurak haydagan qon sistemali qon aylanişining yuqori bosimli qismidan (ya’ni aortadan) past bosimli tomoniga (ya’ni kovak venalarga) ketma-ket va parallel joylaşgan köp kilometrli qon tomirlari orqali oqadi. Arteriyalar, arteriolalar, kapillyarlar, venulalar va venalar birgalikda ketma-ket joylaşgan. Qon tomirlari ketma-ket joylaşganda har bir qon tomiri orqali ötadigan oqim bir xil böladi va qon oqimiga umumiy qarşilik (Rumumiy) har bir tomir qarşiliklarining yiğindisiga teng:
ch14-f74.lead: Ketma-ket va parallel tomir zanjirlarida qon oqimiga qarşilik.

ch14-f75.text: Şunday qilib, umumiy periferik tomir qarşiligi arteriyalar, arteriolalar, kapillyarlar, venulalar va venalar qarşiliklarining yiğindisiga teng. **Rasm 14-9A** da körsatilgan misolda umumiy tomir qarşiligi R1 va R2 ning yiğindisiga teng.

ch14-f77.text: Qon tomirlari keng tarmoqlanib, tanadagi köplab a’zo va töqimalarni qon bilan ta’minlaydigan parallel zanjirlarni hosil qiladi. Bunday parallel joylaşuv har bir töqimaga öz qon oqimini boşqa töqimalardagi oqimdan katta darajada mustaqil ravişda boşqariş imkonini beradi.

ch14-f78.text: Parallel joylaşgan qon tomirlari uçun (**Rasm 14-9B**) qon oqimiga umumiy qarşilik quyidagiça ifodalanadi:

ch14-f79.text: Ravşanki, ma’lum bosim gradiyentida bu parallel tizim orqali alohida olingan har qanday qon tomiri orqali ötadiganidan ança köp qon oqadi. Şuning uçun umumiy qarşilik har qanday bitta qon tomirining qarşiligidan ança kiçik. **Rasm 14-9B** dagi parallel tomirlarning har biri orqali ötadigan oqim boşqa parallel qon tomirlarining qarşiligi bilan emas, balki bosim gradiyenti va şu tomirning öz qarşiligi bilan belgilanadi. Biroq qon tomirlarining istalgan birining qarşiligi ortişi umumiy tomir qarşiligini oşiradi.

ch14-f80.text: Zanjirga köproq qon tomirlari qöşilişi umumiy tomir qarşiligini kamaytirişi paradoks bölib tuyulişi mumkin. Biroq köplab parallel qon tomirlari qonning zanjir orqali oqişini osonlaştiradi, çunki har bir parallel tomir qon oqimi uçun qöşimça yöl, ya’ni _ötkazuvçanlik_ yaratadi. Qon oqimi uçun umumiy ötkazuvçanlik (Cumumiy) har bir parallel yöl ötkazuvçanliklarining yiğindisiga teng:

ch14-f81.text: Masalan, boş miya, buyrak, muskullar, oşqozon-içak, teri va koronar qon aylanişlari parallel joylaşgan va har bir töqima sistemali qon aylanişining umumiy ötkazuvçanligiga öz hissasini qöşadi. Har bir töqima orqali ötadigan qon oqimi umumiy qon oqimining (yurak çiqarişining) bir qismi bölib, töqimadagi qon oqimiga qarşilik (ötkazuvçanlikka teskari kattalik) hamda bosim gradiyenti bilan belgilanadi. Şuning uçun oyoq-qölning amputatsiyasi yoki buyrakning jarrohlik yöli bilan olib taşlanişi parallel zanjirni ham yöq qiladi va umumiy tomir ötkazuvçanligini hamda umumiy qon oqimini (ya’ni yurak çiqarişini) kamaytiradi, umumiy periferik tomir qarşiligini esa oşiradi.

ch14-f82.text: Qon gematokriti va qon qovuşqoqligining tomir qarşiligi va qon oqimiga ta’siri

ch14-f83.text: E’tibor beringki, Puazeyl tenglamasidagi yana bir muhim omil — qonning qovuşqoqligi. Boşqa barça omillar özgarmas bölganda qovuşqoqlik qançalik katta bölsa, tomirdagi oqim şunçalik kam böladi. Bundan taşqari, _me’yoriy qonning qovuşqoqligi suvning qovuşqoqligidan taxminan uç barobar katta._

ch14-f84.text: Qonni nima bunçalik qovuşqoq qiladi? Bu asosan qonda muallaq holatda bölgan köp sonli eritrotsitlar bölib, ularning har biri qöşni hujayralarga va qon tomiri devoriga işqalaniş qarşiligini körsatadi.

ch14-f85.text: Agar odamning gematokriti 40 bölsa, bu qon hajmining 40% i hujayralardan, qolgan qismi esa plazmadan iborat ekanligini bildiradi. Katta yoşli erkaklarda gematokrit örtaça taxminan 42, ayollarda esa örtaça taxminan 38 ga teng. Bu qiymatlar odamda kamqonlik bor-yöqligiga, jismoniy faollik darajasiga va odam yaşaydigan joyning dengiz sathidan balandligiga qarab katta farq qilişi mumkin. Gematokritdagi bu özgarişlar 33-bobda eritrotsitlar va ularning kislorod taşiş funksiyasi bilan boğliq holda muhokama qilinadi.

ch14-f86.text: **Rasm 14-10** da körsatilganidek, gematokrit qonni darajalangan probirkada sentrifugalaş yöli bilan aniqlanadi. Darajalar hujayralar foizini bevosita öqiş imkonini beradi.

ch14-f88.text: **Rasm 14-11** da körsatilganidek, gematokrit ortişi bilan qon qovuşqoqligi keskin ortadi. Me’yoriy gematokritda butun qonning qovuşqoqligi taxminan 3–4 ga teng; bu butun qonni bir xil qon tomiri orqali ötkaziş uçun suvni ötkazişdagiga qaraganda uç-tört barobar köp bosim talab qilinişini anglatadi. Gematokrit 60 yoki 70 gaça kötarilganda — bu _politsitemiya_ bölgan odamlarda tez-tez kuzatiladi — qon qovuşqoqligi suvnikidan 10 barobargaça katta bölişi mumkin va uning qon tomirlari orqali oqişi juda sekinlaşadi.
ch14-f88.lead: Gematokritning ortişi qon qovuşqoqligini keskin oşiradi.

ch14-f90.text: Qon qovuşqoqligiga ta’sir qiluvçi boşqa omillar — plazmadagi oqsillar konsentratsiyasi va oqsillar turlari, biroq bu ta’sirlar gematokrit ta’siridan şunçalik kiçikki, köpçilik gemodinamik tadqiqotlarda ular muhim ahamiyatga ega emas. Qon plazmasining qovuşqoqligi suvnikidan taxminan 1,5 barobar katta.

ch14-f91.text: Bosimning tomir qarşiligi va töqima qon oqimiga ta’siri

ch14-f92.text: Hozirgaça bölgan muhokamadan arterial bosimning ortişi tana töqimalari orqali ötadigan qon oqimining mutanosib ravişda ortişiga olib keladi, deb kutiş mumkin. Biroq **Rasm 14-12** da körsatilganidek, köplab töqimalarda arterial bosimning qon oqimiga ta’siri odatda kutilganidan ança kam böladi. Buning sababi şundaki, arterial bosimning ortişi nafaqat qonni tomirlar orqali itaruvçi kuçni oşiradi, balki 17-bobda muhokama qilinadigan mahalliy boşqaruv mexanizmlarini faollaştiriş orqali bir neça soniya içida tomir qarşiligining kompensator ortişini ham boşlab beradi. Aksinça, arterial bosim pasayganda köpçilik töqimalarda tomir qarşiligi tezda kamayadi va qon oqimi nisbatan doimiy darajada saqlanib qoladi. Har bir töqimaning arterial bosim taxminan 70 dan 175 mm Hg gaça oraliqda özgarganda öz tomir qarşiligini moslaştiriş va me’yoriy qon oqimini saqlab turiş qobiliyati _qon oqimining autoregulyatsiyasi_ deb ataladi.
ch14-f92.lead: Autoregulyatsiya arterial bosimning töqima qon oqimiga ta’sirini susaytiradi.

ch14-f94.text: **Rasm 14-12** da e’tibor beringki, qon oqimining özgarişlari qon tomirlarini _toraytiruvçi_ kuçli simpatik qözğaliş natijasida yuzaga kelişi mumkin. Xuddi şunday, _noradrenalin (norepinefrin), angiotenzin II, vazopressin_ yoki _endotelin_ kabi gormonal vazokonstriktorlar ham qon oqimini heç bölmaganda vaqtinça kamaytirişi mumkin.

ch14-f95.text: Köpçilik töqimalarda arterial bosimning ortişi yoki vazokonstriktorlar darajasining kötarilişi uzoq saqlanib qolgan taqdirda ham qon oqimining özgarişlari kamdan-kam hollarda bir neça soatdan ortiq davom etadi. Qon oqimining nisbatan doimiyligining sababi şundaki, har bir töqimaning mahalliy autoregulyator mexanizmlari oxir-oqibat vazokonstriktorlar ta’sirining köp qismini bartaraf etib, töqima ehtiyojlariga mos keladigan qon oqimini ta’minlaydi.

ch14-f96.text: Ajratib olingan qon tomirlarida yoki autoregulyatsiya kuzatilmaydigan töqimalarda arterial bosimning özgarişlari qon oqimiga muhim ta’sir körsatişi mumkin. **Rasm 14-13** dagi yuqoriga egilgan çiziqlarda körsatilganidek, bosimning qon oqimiga ta’siri Puazeyl tenglamasi başorat qilganidan kattaroq bölişi mumkin. Buning sababi şundaki, arterial bosimning ortişi nafaqat qonni tomirlar orqali itaruvçi kuçni oşiradi, balki elastik tomirlarni çözib kengaytiradi va şu bilan tomir qarşiligini amalda _kamaytiradi_. Aksinça, passiv qon tomirlarida arterial bosimning pasayişi qarşilikni oşiradi, çunki kengaytiruvçi bosim kamayişi tufayli elastik tomirlar asta-sekin puçayib boradi. Bosim _kritik yopiliş bosimi_ deb ataladigan kritik darajadan pastga tuşganda qon tomirlari butunlay puçayib qolgani sababli oqim töxtaydi.
ch14-f96.lead: Passiv tomir törlarida bosim va oqim örtasidagi boğliqlik.

ch14-f98.text: Simpatik qözğaliş va boşqa vazokonstriktorlar **Rasm 14-13** da körsatilgan passiv bosim-oqim boğliqligini özgartirişi mumkin. Şunday qilib, simpatik faollikning _susayişi_ tomirlarni _kuçli kengaytiradi_ va qon oqimini ikki barobar yoki undan köproq oşirişi mumkin. Aksinça, juda kuçli simpatik qözğaliş tomirlarni şu darajada _toraytirişi_ mumkinki, arterial bosim yuqori bölişiga qaramay qon oqimi ba’zan bir neça soniya davomida nolgaça kamayadi.

ch14-f99.text: Aslida töqimalar **Rasm 14-13** da körsatilgan passiv bosim-oqim boğliqligini namoyon qiladigan fiziologik holatlar kam. 17-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, arterial bosimning ötkir özgarişlari paytida qon oqimini samarali autoregulyatsiya qila olmaydigan töqimalarda ham bosim özgarişlari uzoq saqlanib qolganda qon oqimi töqima ehtiyojlariga muvofiq boşqariladi.

ch14-f100.text: Qon tomiri devorining tarangligi transmural bosim gradiyentlariga javoban yuzaga keladi va tomir silliq muskul hujayralari hamda endotelial hujayralarni barça yönalişlarda çözadi (**Rasm 14-14A**). _Laplas qonuniga_ köra, yupqa devorli nayça uçun devor tarangligi (T) transmural bosim gradiyenti (ΔP) bilan qon tomiri radiusi (_r_) köpaytmasining devor qalinligiga (h) nisbatiga proporsional:

ch14-f102.text: Şunday qilib, aorta kabi yuqori bosim ta’siridagi yirik qon tomirlari yuqoriroq taranglikka bardoş beriş uçun mustahkamroq devorlarga ega bölişi kerak va ular odatda kollagenning fibroz tasmalari bilan mustahkamlangan böladi. Aksinça, kapillyarlarning radiuslari ança kiçik va şuning uçun ularga ta’sir qiladigan devor tarangligi ança past böladi; bu ularga buyraklar kabi ba’zi a’zolarda 65–70 mm Hg gaça bölgan bosimlarga bardoş beriş imkonini beradi. 17-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, qon bosimining surunkali özgarişlari devor tarangligidagi tegişli özgarişlarga moslaşiş uçun qon tomirlarining qayta tuzilişiga (remodellanişiga) olib keladi.

ch14-f103.text: Qon oqar ekan, u qon tomirlarini içki tomondan qoplab turuvçi endotelial hujayralarga işqalaniş kuçi, ya’ni tortuvçi kuç ta’sir körsatadi (qarang: **Rasm 14-14B**). _Siljiş kuçlanişi_ (şear stress) deb ataladigan bu kuç qon oqimi tezligi va qon qovuşqoqligiga proporsional, radiusning kubiga esa teskari boğliq bölib, odatda kuç/birlik yuza birliklarida (masalan, din/sm2) ifodalanadi. Klinik amaliyotda siljiş kuçlanişini ölçaşning keng qöllaniladigan yagona usuli yöq. Biroq qisqaruvçi kuçlar yoki qon bosimi tufayli devorning çözilişiga nisbatan kattaligi nisbatan kiçik bölişiga qaramay, siljiş kuçlanişi tomirlar tizimining rivojlanişi va töqimalarning qon oqimiga bölgan ehtiyojlariga moslaşişida muhim ahamiyatga ega. Endotelial hujayralarda birgalikda mexanik sensorlar vazifasini bajaradigan va signal yöllarini boşqaradigan köplab oqsillar mavjud; bu yöllar embrional rivojlaniş davrida tomirlar tarmoğini şakllantiradi va 17-bobda batafsilroq muhokama qilinganidek, katta yoşda ham töqimalarga qon yetkazilişini optimallaştiriş uçun qon tomirlari morfologiyasini özgartirişda davom etadi.
